title: Keemo Paul Inspires Kingsmen to 51-Run Win
short_title: Paul stars in Kingsmen's second straight win
description: Keemo Paul made 65 and took three wickets as Jamaica Kingsmen defeated St Kitts and Nevis Patriots by 51 runs.
dek: Jamaica recovered from 0 for 2 to score 181 for 6 before dismissing the Patriots for 130 at Sabina Park.
image_alt: Keemo Paul represents Jamaica Kingsmen at Sabina Park
summary_heading: Paul leads a recovery and then finishes the defence
key_points: Jamaica Kingsmen won by 51 runs at Sabina Park.
Keemo Paul hit 65 from 36 balls and took 3 for 30.
The Patriots were bowled out for 130 in 18 overs.
players_heading: Key performers from Jamaica's home finale

sections.heading: Paul and Powell rebuild from 0 for 2
paragraphs: Saurabh Netravalkar removed two batters in the opening over, but Keemo Paul and Rovman Powell responded with a 99-run fifth-wicket partnership. Paul accelerated to a career-best 65 from 36 balls.
The full game is available in the Kingsmen vs Patriots match centre.

sections.heading: Patriots lose wickets throughout the chase
paragraphs: The visitors slipped to 31 for 3 and never established the partnership required to challenge 182. Kevin Wickham made 37, but the asking rate continued to climb.
Team information is available on the Jamaica Kingsmen page and Patriots page.

sections.heading: Paul completes the all-round display
paragraphs: Andre Russell took 2 for 19 before Paul returned to the attack. Kevin Wickham's 37 offered the Patriots their clearest resistance, but wickets on either side left the chase without a finishing partnership.
Paul claimed the final two wickets to finish with 3 for 30. The Patriots were dismissed for 130 in 18 overs, completing a 51-run margin in Jamaica's final home match.
Jamaica's second consecutive win is reflected on the CPL 2026 points table.
